products.name: Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS) Therapy Systems for Epilepsy
products.description: Implantable neuromodulation devices and systems, including pulse generators and leads, designed to deliver vagus nerve stimulation as adjunctive therapy for drug-resistant epilepsy. products.name: Vagus Nerve Stimulation (VNS) Therapy Systems for Depression
products.description: Implantable neuromodulation devices and systems, including pulse generators and leads, designed to deliver vagus nerve stimulation as adjunctive therapy for treatment-resistant depression. products.name: Implantable Neurostimulation Systems for Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA)
products.description: Implantable neurostimulation device systems, such as the aura6000 System, designed to treat obstructive sleep apnea by stimulating the hypoglossal nerve to open the airway during sleep. These are manufactured, surgically implanted devices with advanced algorithms for targeted nerve activation.

products.name: Modifier Gene Therapy Platform for Retinal Diseases
products.description: A gene therapy platform utilizing nuclear hormone receptor (NHR) genes delivered via AAV vectors to treat inherited retinal diseases (IRDs) such as retinitis pigmentosa (RP), Stargardt disease (ST), and geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to dry age-related macular degeneration (dAMD). Delivered as a one-time subretinal injection, this therapy is designed to restore retinal function across multiple genetic mutations.

products.name: Novel Biologic Therapy for Retinal Diseases
products.description: A recombinant fusion protein (OCU200) combining human tumstatin and transferrin, administered via intravitreal injection, designed to treat vascular complications of diabetic macular edema (DME), diabetic retinopathy (DR), and wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD) by targeting angiogenesis, inflammation, and oxidative stress pathways.

products.name: Regenerative Medicine Cell Therapy for Knee Cartilage Repair (NeoCart)

products.name: Inhaled Mucosal Vaccine Platform

products.name: Tumor Activated T Cell Engager (TRACTr) Immunotherapies
products.description: Biologics manufactured using recombinant technology that combine a tumor antigen-binding domain and a CD3 T cell binding domain, with proprietary peptide masks and albumin-binding domains, designed to be selectively activated in the tumor microenvironment for the treatment of solid tumors. Delivered as off-the-shelf, injectable therapeutics produced via standard monoclonal antibody processes.

products.name: Tumor Activated Immunomodulator (TRACIr) Immunotherapies
products.description: Bispecific biologic drugs produced using recombinant antibody technology, featuring a tumor antigen-binding domain and a costimulatory CD28 binding domain, with modular peptide masking and albumin-binding domains, designed for selective activation in tumors to enhance T cell activation and durability in solid tumor treatment. Delivered as off-the-shelf, injectable therapeutics.

products.name: Adaptive Immune Response Modulator (ARM) Immunotherapies
products.description: Bispecific antibody-based biologics engineered to deplete B cells in blood and lymphoid tissues, using tumor-activated masking technology for controlled T cell activation, aimed at treating autoimmune diseases. Manufactured via standard monoclonal antibody processes and delivered as off-the-shelf, subcutaneous, re-dosable therapies.

products.description: Precast concrete products for agricultural use, such as cattleguards, water and feed troughs, manufactured in company facilities and delivered to farms and agricultural customers.

products.description: Licensing of proprietary precast concrete products and systems (e.g., J-J Hooks, SlenderWall, Easi-Set/Easi-Span, SoftSound, Beach Prisms) to other manufacturers, including training, marketing support, and royalty arrangements.

products.description: Custom-designed and engineered electrical infrastructure systems for utility-scale, commercial, community, and industrial solar projects, manufactured in-house and delivered as integrated solutions that include proprietary components, design/engineering support, and installation guidance.

products.description: Custom, semi-custom, and standardized electrical infrastructure products and systems for integrating battery energy storage into solar, standalone storage, and data center projects, including prefabricated wiring, disconnect switches, and the proprietary Recombiner platform, all manufactured and engineered for efficient, scalable deployment.

products.description: Electrical infrastructure solutions for data centers, leveraging Shoals’ expertise in DC power distribution and system-level EBOS design, including products adapted from BESS and solar applications to support mission-critical data center power needs.

products.name: Solar OEM Components
products.description: Manufactured electrical components supplied to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the solar industry, including specialized wire harnesses, connectors, and monitoring systems, produced in Shoals’ facilities and integrated into broader solar solutions.

products.description: Professional installation of various insulation materials (fiberglass batts and rolls, blown-in fiberglass, spray foam, cellulose) for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings, delivered through in-person labor and project management across over 200 branches.

products.description: Installation, re-roofing, and maintenance of commercial and industrial roofing systems (single-ply, built-up, metal), requiring skilled labor, project management, and regulated construction practices.

products.name: Software Distribution

products.name: Cloud Services

products.name: Systems Design and Integration Solutions
products.description: Design and integration of IT systems, including build-to-order and configure-to-order assembly, full rack integration, and custom solutions for data center servers and networking. products.name: Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of logistics support including outsourced fulfillment, virtual distribution, direct ship to end-users, transportation management, inventory optimization, reverse logistics, asset refurbishment, and strategic procurement. products.name: Depot Repair and Field Services
products.description: Provision of depot repair and field services for IT products, including repair, installation, and maintenance by certified engineers and technicians. Services support OEMs and end-users, enabling comprehensive repair and on-site support for complex technology environments.

products.name: Online Services and E-Commerce Platforms

products.name: Live Biotherapeutic Products for Infectious Disease and Immune/Inflammatory Disorders

Delivered as capsules or oral liquid formulations for patients unable to swallow capsules.

products.name: VOWST (Microbiome Therapeutic for Clostridioides difficile Infection)
products.description: An FDA-approved, orally administered microbiome biotherapeutic (formerly SER-109) developed to prevent recurrence of Clostridioides difficile infection by restoring gut microbiome function. Manufactured using cultivated bacterial consortia and delivered in oral capsule form.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services

products.description: Brokerage and advisory services for commercial property transactions, including sales, leasing, and development, provided by licensed agents with specialized training and supported by digital tools and in-person expertise.

products.name: Real Estate Brokerage Franchising
products.description: Franchising of real estate brokerage agencies, providing franchisees with brand licensing, proprietary technology, training, and business methodology, delivered as a package with ongoing support and royalty-based revenue model.

products.name: Real Estate Coaching and Training Services
products.description: Education, coaching, and mentoring services for real estate agents and brokers, including core competency courses, business development, and advanced real estate topics, delivered through in-person and digital formats.

products.name: Residential HVAC Systems and Solutions

products.name: Transport Refrigeration Systems and Solutions
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of refrigeration systems for temperature-controlled transport, including truck, trailer, bus, rail, and container refrigeration units, as well as auxiliary power units. Delivered via physical manufacturing and installation on vehicles.

products.name: Custom and Industrial Refrigeration Solutions
products.description: Provision of specialized refrigeration products for industrial processes, medical-grade applications, ultra-low temperature storage, and cold storage facilities. Involves custom engineering, manufacturing, and installation.

products.name: Building Controls and Management Systems
products.description: Development and sale of building management systems, control systems, thermostats, and associated digital solutions for monitoring and optimizing building performance. Delivered as digital and hardware solutions, often integrated with HVAC systems.

products.name: Energy and Decarbonization Services
products.description: Provision of energy efficiency, decarbonization, and renewable energy solutions for buildings, including energy audits, infrastructure upgrades, and energy storage projects. Delivered through consulting, project management, and installation services.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts, Supplies, and Service Agreements
products.description: Sale of replacement parts, supplies, and consumables for HVAC and refrigeration systems, as well as ongoing service agreements, repair, and maintenance services. Delivered through distribution networks and service teams.

products.name: Rental and Temporary Climate Solutions
products.description: Rental of HVAC and refrigeration equipment, including temporary heating, cooling, and cold storage solutions for short-term needs. Delivered via equipment deployment and support services.

products.name: Digital and Smart Services
products.description: Provision of smart, AI-enabled, and telematics solutions for remote monitoring, performance optimization, and asset management of HVAC and refrigeration systems. Delivered as digital platforms and applications.

products.name: Toggle MRAM Products
products.description: High performance, non-volatile memory components manufactured using magnetic-bit technology, available in various densities and industry-standard interfaces, delivered as discrete components for integration into industrial, medical, automotive, and data center applications.

products.name: Spin-Transfer Torque MRAM (STT-MRAM) Products
products.description: High density, persistent memory products manufactured on advanced CMOS nodes, targeting DRAM, SRAM, and NOR Flash replacement in data center, industrial IoT, AI, and automotive applications, delivered as discrete memory components with standardized interfaces.

products.name: Tunnel Magneto Resistance (TMR) Sensors
products.description: 3D magnetic field sensors manufactured as die-level components, providing high sensitivity for integration into consumer electronics requiring 3D compass functionality.

products.name: Licensing and Royalty of MRAM and TMR Sensor IP
products.description: Licensing of MRAM and TMR sensor intellectual property, including technology and design licenses, to third parties such as semiconductor foundries and aerospace customers, generating royalty and patent sale revenue streams.

products.name: Foundry Services for MRAM and TMR Sensor Integration
products.description: Back end of line (BEOL) manufacturing services performed at the Chandler facility, enabling customers to add MRAM and TMR sensor functionality to their base CMOS wafers, primarily for aerospace and satellite electronics.

products.name: Laminated and Decorative Surface Products
products.description: Manufactures and distributes laminated panels, decorative and wrapped vinyls, paper-laminated panels, vinyl printing, and related surface products for use in furniture, shelving, walls, and countertops. products.name: Countertops and Solid Surface Products
products.description: Produces and supplies solid surface, granite, and quartz countertops for RV, marine, manufactured housing, and industrial markets. These are manufactured in-house using specialized fabrication and finishing processes.

products.description: Manufactures and distributes cabinet products, doors, custom cabinetry, hardwood profile mouldings, and related wood components for OEMs in RV, marine, MH, and industrial markets. Production requires woodworking, finishing, and assembly operations.

products.name: Doors and Integrated Door Systems
products.description: Produces interior passage doors, baggage doors, integrated door systems, and related components for RV, MH, marine, and industrial applications. Involves woodworking, assembly, and finishing processes.

products.name: Uranium Contract Sales and Supply Services

products.name: Non-Core Asset Divestment and Project Sales
